stories.title: Vance downplays AI fears: Heritage Foundation warns against regulation
stories.simple_summary: A political group says the government shouldn't make strict rules about AI right now.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to politicians and investors — nothing you need to act on immediately.

stories.title: Newt Gingrich warns US could face grave danger if it falls behind on artificial intelligence
stories.simple_summary: A politician is warning that America could have serious problems if other countries get better at AI than we do.
stories.why_it_matters: This is political talk rather than actual AI news affecting your daily life or business.

stories.title: Stock Market News From Sept. 14, 2026: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq Fall Amid AI Fears; Micron, Marvell, Intel, More Movers
stories.simple_summary: Stock prices fell partly because people are worried about AI's effects on businesses.
stories.why_it_matters: If you have retirement savings or investments, this is worth watching, but it's about the stock market, not AI itself.

stories.title: Is Big Tech’s AI slowdown a safety pact or a cartel?
stories.simple_summary: The big AI companies said they'll slow down how fast they're building new AI, but some people think they're just pretending to avoid government rules.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to big tech investors — for ordinary people, AI development speed won't affect you either way right now.

stories.title: AI CEOs say they need to slow the pace of development. But will they?
stories.simple_summary: AI company leaders say they want to develop AI more slowly and carefully, but people wonder if they'll actually do it.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and tech workers — nothing you need to worry about for your business today.

stories.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang tells Trump ‘we’re not going to let [an AI slowdown] happen’
stories.simple_summary: Nvidia's leader says his company won't slow down AI development, disagreeing with other tech leaders.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly about tech business competition and investor concerns — not something affecting ordinary people or small businesses.

stories.title: What execs and politicians are saying about slowing down AI development
stories.simple_summary: Business leaders and politicians are arguing about whether AI should be developed faster or slower, with different opinions.
stories.why_it_matters: This is political debate rather than practical AI changes affecting you right now.

stories.title: Trump says AI doesn’t need guardrails, only a ‘high IQ’ president
stories.simple_summary: A politician said AI doesn't need safety rules, just smart leadership.
stories.why_it_matters: This is political talk — it doesn't affect what AI can actually do for your business today.

stories.title: OpenAI buys smartphone camera maker Glass Imaging for $300 million, report says
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI (a major AI company) bought a small company that makes camera technology, spending 300 million dollars.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors in tech companies — it's a business deal, not something affecting regular AI users or small business owners.

stories.title: Hakeem Jeffries: Congress must act ‘immediately’ to rein in AI
stories.simple_summary: A politician is saying Congress needs to pass laws to control and limit AI right away.
stories.why_it_matters: This is political debate about future rules — nothing you need to act on yet for your business.

stories.title: Jensen Huang puts Trump on speakerphone onstage to announce robots won’t take over the world
stories.simple_summary: An AI company leader talked to the President on stage at an event and said robots won't take over the world.
stories.why_it_matters: This is just news about what people are saying at events — it's not a real change in what AI can do.

stories.title: How China is preparing for the risk of AI escaping human control
stories.simple_summary: China is planning how to handle the risk of AI systems becoming too powerful to control.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly about international competition and government planning — it doesn't affect your daily life or small business right now.
